description_excerpt: Job Description • Receive, register and process customer samples in the system, including sample coding and documentation management. • Review customer requirements and create testing orders, ensuring the correct test methods, parameters and laboratories are assigned for each request. • Prepare and send order confirmations, communicate updates, and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure timely order execution. • Monitor testing progress, including subcontracted analyses, and follow up on results to ensure service quality and turnaround time. • Handle invoicing and payment collection…
